items.subject: Fixture Loop A
items.text: Fixture Loop A is a waymarked route of 12.4 km with 300 m of ascent that starts and finishes at the same place.

items.subject: Fixture Line B
items.text: Fixture Line B covers 30.0 km between two villages.

items.subject: Fixtureville, Nowhere
items.text: Canal town famous for its cheese market and a Gothic cathedral.

source.text: Fixtureville is a small canal town known for its weekly cheese market.

items.subject: Fixtureburg, Nowhere
items.text: Hilltop castle town above the river.

source.text: Fixtureburg lies on flat polder land far from any river.
